**Directions: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

One of / the biggest enterprise / in India / is declaring a lockout.
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'the biggest enterprise' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the given sentence, the singular form of the noun ''enterprise'' is incorrect. • The **phrase ''One of''** in the given sentence is a **singular term** and is generally **used to talk about a noun or a pronoun**. • The **noun or a pronoun used after** the **phrase ''one of''** is **always in the plural form** (as we are talking of one person/place/thing out of many). • Therefore, the plural form of the noun ''enterprises'' should be used in place of the singular noun 'enterprise'. • Also, the **helping verb will always be in the singular form** (here, **is**), as the **helping verb agrees with ''one of''** and **not with the plural noun** in the sentence. Hence, the correct answer is option 1. Correct sentence: *One of **the biggest enterprises** in India is declaring a lockout*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • Subjects and verbs must agree with one another in number (singular or plural). (विषय और क्रिया एक दूसरे के साथ संख्या (एकवचन या बहुवचन) में सहमत होना चाहिए) • Thus, if a subject is singular, its verb must also be singular; if the subject is plural, its verb must also be plural. (इस प्रकार, यदि कोई विषय एकवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी एकवचन होनी चाहिए ; यदि विषय बहुवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी बहुवचन होनी चाहिए) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिए गए वाक्य में noun ''enterprise'' का **एकवचन रूप गलत है**। • दिए गए वाक्य में phrase ''One of'' **एकवचन शब्द है** और आमतौर पर **संज्ञा या सर्वनाम के बारे में बात करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है**। • Phrase ''one of'' **के बाद प्रयुक्त संज्ञा या सर्वनाम हमेशा बहुवचन रूप में होता है** (जैसा कि हम कई में से एक व्यक्ति/स्थान/वस्तु की बात कर रहे हैं)। • इसलिए **एकवचन** noun 'enterprise' के स्थान पर बहुवचन noun ''enterprises'' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • साथ ही, **सहायक क्रिया हमेशा एकवचन रूप में होगी** (यहाँ, **is**), क्योंकि **सहायक क्रिया 'one of' से सहमत होती है**, **न कि वाक्य में बहुवचन संज्ञा के साथ**। अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है। सही वाक्य: *One of the biggest enterprises in India is declaring a lockout*. 2f:T19d1, The correct answer is 'from childhood' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

questions.question:
**Directions: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

I never miss / a cricket match / as I am fond of cricket / from childhood.

options.text: as I am fond of cricket

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'from childhood' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the preposition 'from' is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'from' is used **for showing the place, direction, or time that somebody or something starts or started**.
 
• The use of the word 'childhood' in the sentence indicates **the time when you are a child**.
 
• Therefore, the preposition 'since' should be used in place of the preposition 'from'.
 
• The preposition 'since' means **from a particular time in the past until a later time in the past or until now**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Sentence: *I never miss a cricket match as I am fond of cricket **since childhood***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में preposition 'from' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Preposition 'from' का अर्थ है **स्‍थान, दिशा या समय की दृष्टि से किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के कुछ आरंभ करने या होने का सूचक; से**।
 
• वाक्य में 'childhood' शब्द का प्रयोग **उस समय को इंगित करता है जब आप बच्चे होते हैं**।
 
• इसलिए, preposition 'since' का प्रयोग preposition 'from' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Preposition 'since' का अर्थ है **अभी तक; तब से अब तक**।

 

अतः सही उत्तर option 1 है।

सही वाक्य: *I never miss a cricket match as I am fond of cricket since childhood*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Sculpture and painting form an integral part of temple architecture.

B. The city is visited by thousands curious to see the temple in the form of a chariot.

C. The finest example of this is Konark Temple in Puri.

D. The chariot with immense wheels and horses is carved from stone.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'ACBD.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'A' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "temple architecture". Hence, 'A' is the first part.
 
• Sentence C will come after A as it is giving information about the finest example of temple architecture (**Konark Temple in Puri**).
 
• Sentence B will come after C as it is giving information about the curiosity behind the visit of thousands of people to the city 'Puri'.
 
• The sentence 'D' is the concluding part as it is giving information about the material used to carve the chariot-shaped temple.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *Sculpture and painting form an integral part of temple architecture. The finest example of this is Konark Temple in Puri. The city is visited by thousands curious to see the temple in the form of a chariot. The chariot with immense wheels and horses is carved from stone.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'A' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह **"मंदिर वास्तुकला"** के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'A' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य C, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह मंदिर वास्तुकला (पुरी में कोणार्क मंदिर) के बेहतरीन उदाहरण के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य B, C के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह हजारों लोगों के पुरी शहर की यात्रा के पीछे की जिज्ञासा के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य '**D**' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह रथ के आकार के मंदिर को तराशने के लिए प्रयुक्त सामग्री के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है।

**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

The French scientist said, “I want to study how bees and wasps find their way home.”

options.text: The French scientist said that I wanted to study how bees and wasps find their way home.
The French scientist said that he wants to study how bees and wasps found your way home.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The French scientist said that he wanted to study how bees and wasps found their way home**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed, and 'that' is added.
 
• The first-person pronoun ''I'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''he''.
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (want) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (wanted) + Object'.
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (find) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (found) + Object'.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object)
 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past simple (Subject+V2+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object)
 Past perfect continuous (Subject+had been+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Future simple (Subject+ will/shall+V1+object)
 Present Conditional (Subject+would+V1+object)
 
 

 Future Continuous (Subject +will/shall+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Conditional Continuous (Subject +would+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने या बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas हटा दिए जाते हैं और 'that' जोड़ा जाता है।
 
• The first-person pronoun ''I'', third-person pronoun ''he'' बन जाता है।
 
• Present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (want) + Object' को past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (wanted) + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• Present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (find) + Object' को past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (found) + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

The shopkeeper would have fined her if __he come to know__ that she damaged the toy on exhibit.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**he had come to know**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the simple present form of the verb ''come'' is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is the third conditional sentence explaining that present circumstances would be different if something different had happened in the past.
 
• The third conditional sentence structure is as follows:
 
 
• If + past perfect..., + conditional perfect (would + have + past participle).
 
• Conditional perfect (would + have + past participle) + if + past perfect.
 
 
 
• When using the third conditional, we use the past perfect (i.e., had + past participle) in the if-clause and the modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.) + have + past participle in the main clause.
 
• Therefore, the past perfect form of the verb ''had come'' should be used in place of the simple present form of the verb 'come'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *The shopkeeper would have fined her if **he had come to know** that she damaged the toy on exhibit*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• Do not get confused between the** present and past forms of the verb 'come'.**
 
• Here are the correct forms of **come**:-

 
 

 **1st form (Base form)**
 **2ⁿd form (Past form)**
 **3rd form (Past Participle form)**
 
 

 Come
 Came
 Come
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खण्ड में simple present form of the verb ''come'' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य third conditional sentence है जो यह बताता है कि यदि अतीत में कुछ अलग हुआ होता तो वर्तमान परिस्थितियाँ भिन्न होतीं।
 
• Third conditional sentence की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• If + past perfect..., + conditional perfect (would + have + past participle).
 
• Conditional perfect (would + have + past participle) + if + past perfect.
 
 
 
• Third conditional का उपयोग करते समय, हम if-क्लॉज में past perfect (had + past participle) का उपयोग करते हैं और modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.) + have + past participle, main clause में।
 
• अतः verb 'come' के simple present form के स्थान पर past perfect form of the verb ''had come'' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अतः सही उत्तर option 3 है।

सही वाक्य: *The shopkeeper would have fined her if he had come to know that she damaged the toy on exhibit*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Sabotage
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Create.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Sabotage' means **destroying or damaging something deliberately so that it does not work correctly**. (जान-बूझ कर तोड़-फोड़ करना)

 
 
• Example: *The enemy agent used a bomb to **sabotage** the factory and halt production*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
 
 
• '**Damage**' means **to spoil or harm something, for example by breaking it**. (हानि पहुँचाना, नुक़सान करना जैसे कुछ तोड़ देना)
 
 
• Example: *The storm caused property **damage***.
 
 
 
• '**Cripple**' means **to seriously damage or harm somebody or something**. (किसी को गंभीर रूप से क्षतिग्रस्‍त कर देना)
 
 
• Example: *A total cut-off of supplies would **cripple** the country's economy*.
 
 
 
• '**Destroy**' means **to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists**. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
 
 
• Example: *An atomic bomb can **destroy** the whole universe in no time*.
 
 
 
• 'Create' means **bring something into existence**. (कुछ नया उत्‍पन्‍न, रचना, बनाना, करना; अस्तित्व में लाना)
